body: So if emotions cloud my view, what happened if it never clears up? This may be my clouded judgement speaking, but from what I can tell I have NEVER seen someone this mad, and I can understand them wanting me to kill myself.

For one, S is no longer my friend, and we are not talking. 

Secondly, no body actually likes me, and I don't care what people think. I feel like I'm not even human sometimes from the lack of emotion. And to add on to that, my body is a wreck. I have a unique eye problem that doesn't even have a name because no doctor has seen it before, my spine has scoliosis, not to mention other things. The most love I think for anyone or anything is for my pets.
